decisions.reason: Replacing the upper photos does not change the product positioning, target customers, messaging emphasis, or marketing purpose.
The source changes only upper-page photos and does not alter the required client-supplied video.
The photo replacement does not resolve or change the CTA redirect destination or click behavior.
Changing landing-page photos has no effect on the hosting or custom-domain constraints.
The imagery change does not affect the exclusion of Shopify as the landing-page platform.
Replacing upper photos does not change link distribution, recipient access, or the delivery acceptance condition.
